description: A read-only Codex review conclusion for one pull request head snapshot.

prior_resolutions.description: For incremental reviews, one entry for every prior finding, indexed from zero; otherwise an empty array.

summary.description: One or two sentences that state what the change does and the overall conclusion. Never describe what you are about to do or what you are reading.

coverage.description: What the review actually covered. This is the evidence behind an empty findings array, so it may not be empty when nothing was reported.

inspected.description: Repository-relative paths whose current content you read while reviewing. List every file you actually opened, not the files you intended to open; do not add unread paths just to satisfy the coverage check.

uncovered.description: Changed areas you could not judge, each written as path or path:line followed by the reason. An empty array claims every changed hunk was reviewed. A non-empty array is a valid way to close a large review and does not void the conclusion, provided inspected reflects files actually read, but every entry must be rechecked by a human.

findings.description: Every review finding, ordered by severity. An empty array means nothing has to change.

severity.description: Severity level defined by the repository review rubric.

file.description: Repository-relative path the finding points at, or an empty string when it concerns the whole change.

line.description: Line number in the file as it exists in the reviewed head snapshot, or 0 when the finding is not tied to one line.

problem.description: The concrete defect or risk, stated as observable behaviour rather than preference.

suggestion.description: The smallest change that removes the problem.
